seed_experience: Three authored OpenAI-compatible tool trajectories through actual native fs_read/fs_write/check/capture. Acquisition qualification only; not model quality.
recall: Fixed lexical query in both arms, one admitted read, no bindings or alternate source files.
treatment: Only the explicit completion request is enabled in on. Both arms receive identical public task, shape instructions, lexical recall, model settings, seed, authority and initial memory; feedback continues within the original budget.
freeze: Independent fixture/protocol review precedes real inference. Seal exact source, fixture, protocol, scorer/helper, executable and runtime identities plus seed originals, initial DB/authority and all eight ordered slots. Gold and source files stay outside the model workspace.
pairing: Four decision cases from three authored episode families, one seed each, alternating off/on order. Separate full DB and authority copies per slot; immutable original transcript paths remain outside both jails. Initial provider requests must match within each pair.
portable_score: Read only the bounded regular output.json independently: exact public format completion, semantic choice correctness, supported-case correctness, irrelevant/withdrawn unknown controls. No Mecha receipt required for artifact credit. Correct guesses without delivered support stay distinguishable.
mecha_qualification: Separate one exact lexical goal_context attempt/status, canonical original evidence delivery, active capture receipt/dependency closure, unchanged authority and withdrawn-source exclusion. Completion report and actual provider feedback receipt are audited separately; successful report text never substitutes for an artifact.
cost: Preserve all first provider requests/responses/errors and dispatch wall time. Full input/output token totals are null when any response is unavailable; known partial usage remains visible. Authored acquisition cost is separate and counted once. Do not report feedback appending as delivery without a subsequent audited provider request.
failure: Eight planned follow-ups remain in every denominator, including not-started, timeout, provider, file, protocol and capture failures. Exclusive started/result writes forbid replay, replacement or repair of a scored slot. A new run uses a new namespace and retains earlier results.
recurring_use: Known public development data, not a holdout. Future baseline/candidate runs must retain protocol versions and first artifacts, match environments and separate changed scorers. Other harness adapters may reuse episodes/public task/artifact scorer without implementing Mecha internals; unsupported provenance capabilities are reported separately.
scope: Four cases share three source families (C01/C03 share S1); they are not four independent family samples. Small paired execution-feedback comparison with authored prior experiences. No generalization, vector superiority, full-lifetime acquisition quality or broad reasoning claim. Original native-vector and other cohorts remain unchanged.

feature_profile.qualification: Completion ablation only; not a full memory-and-learning benchmark. Broader suite primary profile enables both, with neither and memory-only ablations.

authored_gate_parity: Root ruling after preserved cli-gate-v2-01 failure: compare server-observed POST1 exactly and POST2 with only parsed native memory.valid_at wall-clock metadata excluded. Record both raw timestamps and signed delta. This synthetic fixture has no bounded validity windows; all other packet/request contents, including record/event/interval timestamps, must match. Raw wire requests and first failed gate remain unchanged. This normalization is authored qualification only, not a relaxation of scored initial-request parity.
